name: Evans Syndrome
aliases: Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia with Immune Thrombocytopenia

criteria.description: Presence of autoimmune hemolytic anemia confirmed by positive direct antiglobulin (Coombs) test
Immune thrombocytopenia with platelet count <100,000/µL and exclusion of other causes
Exclusion of secondary causes such as systemic lupus erythematosus, lymphoproliferative disorders, or infections
Simultaneous or sequential occurrence of autoimmune hemolytic anemia and immune thrombocytopenia
Bone marrow examination showing normal or increased megakaryocytes without evidence of malignancy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of autoimmune hemolytic anemia and immune thrombocytopenia with exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by laboratory findings; other autoimmune cytopenias may be present.
